dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/13/Text/3] At pretesting, all of the subjects had scores in excess of 13 on the CDI. At posttesting, 7 of 9 subjects (78%) in the S-C condition, 6 of 10 subjects (60~ in the BPS condition, and 1 of 9 subjects (11%) in the WL condition had scores below 13. Fewer subjects exhibited clinically significant levels of depression on the CDRS-R prior to treatment. Fifty-six percent of the subjects in the S-C condition, 20% of the subjects in the BPS condition, and none of the subjects in the WL condition had scores in excess of 40 on the CDRS-R prior to treatment.
dxgive.warning: Entry criteria based on symptom cutoff (CDI > 13), not formal diagnostic criteria. No mention of diagnostic assessment for inclusion/exclusion.
